alate: The head capsule, pronotum, postmentum and femoral segments are all nearly blackish brown; the labrum and postclypeus brown, the latter paler; the tibiae pale yellow, the wing membrane brown. The head capsule is nearly circular, the fontanelle dot-like, 0.53–0.58 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are nearly circular, the projection rate 6–9 per cent, the long diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are long-oval, the long diameter greater than the ocellus-compound eye distance. The dorsal margin of the head is mound-like, the postclypeus almost not projecting, lower than the vertex and slightly higher than the ocelli. Antennae with 19 segments. The pronotum is trapezoidal, the middle of the anterior margin with a small notch, the middle of the posterior margin distinctly notched. The forewing 8.26–8.57 mm long and 2.21–2.37 mm wide; the hindwing 7.96–8.26 mm long and the same width as the forewing, the cubitus with about fourteen branches.
